headline: Last session: Market remains closed for the weekend as strong corporate earnings take center stage.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Sunday, 8 November.

why: Divi's Laboratories reported a 64% surge in Q2 net profit to Rs 1,127 crore with expanding margins.
Indian Oil clarified that all tested ethanol blending samples were within prescribed limits.
Noel Tata stepped down as Chairman of Voltas and was appointed Chairman Emeritus.
Oil Marketing Companies refuted Karnataka's E20 report and sought details on testing procedures.
whatHappening: Indian equity markets are closed today for the weekend and will reopen on Sunday, 8 November.
Divi's Laboratories registered a 35% revenue growth in Q2 FY27.
Kwality Wall's reported a 44% increase in revenue alongside a net loss of Rs 17 crore.
Madhya Pradesh government took over 30 official websites offline following a cyberattack threat.
summary: Indian stock markets are closed today for the weekend. Corporate earnings drive stock-specific action following Divi's Laboratories' impressive Q2 results. Clarifications on ethanol blending limits from Indian Oil and leadership updates at Voltas also highlighted key market developments.
